leaves.name: javanpeykarThm111
leaves.doc: javanpeykar-direct: Javanpeykar, Algebra Number Theory 8 (2014), Thm 1.1.1, over the print's objects: for Kbar any algebraic closure of Q and X a smooth proper connected integral curve over Kbar (IsCurve), projective (closed immersion into P(n; Spec Kbar)), of genus g = genusK X = dim H^1(X, O_X) >= 1, W an abelian variety over Kbar representing Pic^0_{X/Kbar} with the tensor group law (Jac X), h_Fal(Jac X) = any x with IsStableHeightBar W x (x is height-fix's printed stable height IsPrintedStableHeight of a model of W over some number field L inside Kbar), and deg_B(X) = belyiDegree X hB = Nat.find of the existence of a Belyi map of positive degree (hB: X has a Belyi map, javanpeykar-fix's IsBelyiMap; Belyi's theorem is not used): x <= 13*10^6 * g * deg_B(X)^5. javanpeykarPrintedMapHF follows in Lean (JavanpeykarDirect.javanpeykarPrintedMap_of_thm111: specialization Kbar = AlgebraicClosure K, X = X0 x_K Kbar; deg_B(X) <= d for the given Belyi map and the bound increasing in deg_B; L = K for the model V).
leaves.flag: pending review (Addendum 1: new printed leaf, GLUE until a reviewer rates it); the print over its own objects (deg_B as Nat.find, h_Fal(Jac X) as the stable height of an abelian variety over Qbar via a model over a number field), replacing javanpeykarPrintedMapHF's two reading steps (degree of a given Belyi map; model over the field of definition K) by Lean proofs; remaining readings are definition-level: IsStableHeightBar is Faltings' stable height (independent of the number field and model), height-fix's IsPrintedStableHeight, unramified via the ramification index at closed points
leaves.source: Javanpeykar, Polynomial bounds for Arakelov invariants of Belyi curves, Algebra Number Theory 8 (2014), Thm 1.1.1, p. 90 (arXiv:1403.6404v1 Thm 1.1.1, p. 1); height identification p. 98 (arXiv section 2.3 p. 9); locators recorded by the locator audit (docs/research/locators.md row R18); over height-fix's printed stable height (javanpeykar-direct)
